description: List the user's CoreModels projects as [id,name,accessLevel] (see the response "format" field). Use a returned id as graphProjectId for other tools. Pass searchTerm to filter by name (case-insensitive substring). Set includePublicProjects=true to also include public projects. Set includeAISummary=true to also return each project's saved AI-generated summary and the time it was generated (4th and 5th elements). The response's inLibrary maps each returned id to whether the project is in the Schema Library (schema_library_projects_section); a public project need not be curated into the library, and external library catalog entries are not graph projects listed here. Paged: page is 1-based; increment page up to the returned totalPages to get all results.

includeAISummary.description: When true, each project row includes its saved AI-generated summary (markdown) and the time it was generated as 4th and 5th elements, or null if none has been generated.

includePublicProjects.description: When true, public projects the user is not a member of are also included.

page.description: 1-based page number. Increment to page through results up to totalPages.

searchTerm.description: Optional case-insensitive substring to filter projects by name.

name: list_projects
title: List Projects
